# Container

Containers can be used as main layout with fluid or fixed width.<br />
It implements breakpoints and content area rules.

See [Grid and Layout guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)<br />
See the supported <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="docs">breakpoints</LinkTo>

<Source code="import { Container } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Story of={ContainerStories.Open} />

<Primary />

The default container is fluid: it sets a `width: 100%` at all breakpoints.<br />
With the `until` prop, you can have a fluid container until a specific breakpoint.

If you prefer to design for a fixed set of sizes instead of a fully fluid viewport, you can use the `fixed` prop.<br />
The `max-width` of this container will match the current breakpoint content area.

<Controls />

* Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Container/index.ts)
